place.aSub: The home or office numerology number is calculated by adding the door/building number and the flat number.
place.noRuleForLetters: The source method has no separate rule for numbers containing letters, slashes or hyphens.
place.emptyPrompt: Enter the door and flat numbers to start the calculation.
place.invalidPrompt: Enter both numbers correctly to calculate.
place.bSub: Assesses the compatibility between the person (name + date of birth) and the business/brand name. This is a separate calculation from the Home/Office Number.
place.openingHint: You can leave this blank if the opening date is unknown.
place.unsupportedLetters: Letter not supported by the source alphabet: {letters}
place.businessDigits: Digits in the business name ({digits}) are not in the letter table, so they are not counted.
place.layersInfo: Business compatibility consists of the personal base compatibility, the business name and (if given) the opening date layers. No single overall compatibility score is produced; interpretation should be made by the practitioner.
place.birthInvalid: Enter a valid date of birth (DD/MM/YYYY).
place.businessPrompt: Enter the first name, date of birth and business name to calculate compatibility.

timing.invalidBirth: A valid date of birth is required for the timing and development calculations.
timing.refAny: You can choose a past or future date.
timing.refLimited: You can choose a past date or a date within {year} (permission is required for future years).
timing.refNote: This only changes the calculation's “today”; it does not change the numerology formula.
timing.personalIntro: The annual calculation shows the calendar year, while the active personal year shows the period running from one birthday to the next. That is why the two values can differ.
timing.ageOutOfRange: Age {age}. No life phase cycle range is defined for this age.
timing.phaseFailed: The life phase could not be calculated.

preBirth.note: Pre-birth analysis: the date of birth ({birth}) is after the reference date ({ref}). Number and name calculations are based on this date of birth; values tied to age and the active period begin at birth.
preBirth.activeYear: Before birth — there is no active personal year yet. The first active personal year begins on the birthday ({birth}).
preBirth.evre: Before birth — the life phase begins at birth. First phase: Phase 1.
preBirth.evreWithEnergy: Before birth — the life phase begins at birth. First phase: Phase 1 (energy {energy}).

relationship.triangleRule: If the 2s in the relationship analysis PIN code fall within the relationship PIN triangle (the personality, social awareness, global awareness, inner self, inner child and soul feeling digits), they make the relationship more loving and nurturing. This triangle leaves out the life cycle and lesson digits.
relationship.whyPending: The source text for this digit is pending from the PDF file.
relationship.relTypeTitle: What Kind of Relationship with Whom (directional)
relationship.commonTitle: Common Topic Number — What Do We Agree On?
relationship.levelNote: The source quantity class is defined only for 1=low · 2=sufficient · 3=balanced; no label is produced for other counts.
relationship.modeSub: Dominant / Passive distribution — this is NOT a compatibility score
relationship.modeNote: Each digit 9 contributes 0.5 to both dominant and passive. These values show how the relationship operates; on their own they do not produce a good/bad verdict.
relationship.infoNote: This screen calculates the relationship's Synergy PIN, element distribution and mode of operation. No general/single compatibility percentage is produced. Interpretation should be made by the practitioner based on the relevant training note.
